title: Chapter 218 Curse
content:
Chapter 218 Curse

"It's a curse."

At this time, a member of the Xiao tribe who had been silent suddenly said.

curse?

Lu Xue frowned slightly and looked at the person who spoke.

I saw that it was a member of the Xiao tribe dressed in a commoner. Looking at his left arm, it was empty.

"What's the meaning?"

Lu Xue continued to ask.

The one-armed man sighed, his eyes gradually losing their minds.

"Anyone who enters my Xiao clan's ancestral land will be cursed from here and will never be able to leave here again."

"Once you leave, your soul and soul will be destroyed."

After saying this, all the people present from Xiao clan looked very bad.

Lu Xue is becoming more and more confused.

"Well, can you tell me more clearly? What kind of curse can actually bind you strong people here."

Hearing this, the one-armed man glanced at Lu Xue deeply, and then said, "You are not from my Xiao clan. You shouldn't talk to you about this matter, but since you were sent by my Xiao clan, then Let me explain it clearly to you.”

As he said that, the one-armed man glanced at everyone present, and saw that no one objected, he continued: "Millions of years ago, the fairy world was in turmoil, and a strange stone fell from the sky into my Xiao clan's ancestral land. , There have been earth-shaking changes in my Xiao clan’s ancestral land, and the fairy spirit has become more and more intense. "

"Isn't that a good thing?"

Hearing this, Lu Xue spoke.

However, the one-armed man shook his head.

"That strange stone is indeed a rare treasure, but unfortunately it has been polluted."

“And when we found out, it was too late.”

"Anyone who absorbs the fairy energy that spreads out from the strange stone will no longer be able to do without it. Once it leaves a certain range of the strange stone, its soul will be destroyed and its body will be destroyed."

Strange stone?

Is it really that magical?

Lu Xue felt a little disbelief, but she didn't say it.

However, the one-armed man saw Lu Xue’s inner thoughts at a glance.

"Little girl, this world is big, don't limit your thoughts to what you know."

"For the past tens of millions of years, many of my Xiao clan members have not believed in fate and finally fell on the way down the mountain."

"I saw with my own eyes that a terrifying existence in my Xiao clan, who was above the Immortal Emperor Realm, chose to go down the mountain because of missing Xiao clan, and finally died at the foot of the mountain."

The one-armed man's eyes were red, and tears were scattered in his eyes.

That was a scene he would never forget in his life.

"Senior, please consider it again."

The crowd stood behind an old figure and spoke in a pleading tone.

However, the old man in front of everyone sighed: "Although the ancestral land is the destination of my Xiao tribe, it is my home. There are people in the Xiao tribe who care about me. I just want to die before I die. , look at them again."

The old man's eyes were turbid, but his expression was extremely firm.

In the end, the old man embarked on the road to return home.

All the people from the Xiao clan in the entire ancestral land rushed to see him off.

Everyone looked at the old man with regret and grief.

At this moment, a hint of hope even rose in everyone's heart.

What if?

What if the curse is really broken?

Bang!

At this time, a sound directly shattered the hope in everyone's hearts.

I saw that the old man in the distance had collapsed at the foot of the mountain.

At this moment, the old man's eyes were still looking ahead.

Go a little further, go a little further.

Unfortunately, the old man still didn't get what he wanted, and his eyes gradually lost their minds. In the end, the old man's body turned into a fog and floated around the outside of his ancestral land.

Since then, the one-armed man has been filled with fear of the curse.

Those who can't get out, those who can't get out in their entire lives.

The only thing that is gratifying is that they can still be buried in their ancestral land after their death.

Looking at the one-armed man's depressed face, everyone shook their heads helplessly.

The one-armed man is desperate, why are they the same?

"By the way, I have something to give to you."

Lu Xue took out a ring and handed it on it.

An old man from the Xiao clan took it and a bitter smile appeared on his face.

"Thank you."

I saw a letter and some cultivation resources appeared on the stone table.

The content of the letter is simple.

It records some things that happened to the Xiao clan over the years.

Everyone looked at the content on the envelope and said nothing.

They miss homesick.

"I want to go and see that stone."

I don’t know how long it took, but Lu Xue suddenly spoke, breaking the silence in the stone house.

When everyone heard this, they were slightly stunned.

Lu Xue looked at everyone looking at him, then spread her hands helplessly, "As you said, I have come in, so I can't get out. Then I'll see if that stone is not OK?"

Hearing this, Xiao Yin nodded and said, "It's OK."

Seeing this, the rest of the people nodded slightly.

It just so happened that this girl also revealed a bit of mystery, and she asked her to look at the stone, and maybe she could really see something.

This is what Xiao Yin thought in his heart.

And the other old antiques of Xiao clan felt that it didn't matter anymore.

It's the same thing to watch or not.

Immediately, Xiao Yin took Lu Xue to the back of the stone house.

"When did you come in?"

On the way, Lu Xue suddenly asked.

Hearing Lu Xue’s questions, Xiao Yin did not hide it, “Million years ago.”

Hearing this, Lu Xue nodded slightly.

Among these people, Xiao Yin looked young.

Soon, Lu Xue suddenly felt the fairy aura around her suddenly became a little stronger.

For a moment, Lu Xue felt that her cultivation level had begun to loosen.

This place is really good.

"We're here."

Xiao Yin spoke.

"Huh? Where?"

Lu Xue looked around, but except for the empty space in front of her, she saw nothing else.

At this time, Xiao Yin waved his hand, and a ripples suddenly appeared in the space in front of him.

The next moment, the scene in front of me suddenly changed.

I saw a piece of jade covered with spots lying quietly in front of me.

It turned out that the formation covered the place.

Immediately, Lu Xue and the others walked in. As they got closer, Lu Xue also discovered that the endless fairy aura around them was emitted from the jade in front of her.

"Is this what you call a curse-producing stone?"

Lu Xue asked, pointing to the jade in front of her.

On the side, Xiao Yin nodded and looked at the jade in front of him with an extremely complicated expression.

This piece of jade made them successful and ruined them.

At this time, Xiao Yin suddenly grabbed Lu Xuechao's outstretched arm and said solemnly: "What are you doing?!"

I saw that Lu Xue wanted to go forward and reach out to touch her.

This scared Xiao Yin.

Seeing Xiao Yin so excited, Lu Xue hesitated and said, "Can't you touch it?"

Xiao Yin held his forehead.

"You will die if you touch it."

Xiao Yin said angrily.

"Uh, that's OK."

Immediately, Lu Xue kept a distance from the jade in front of her and began to look around the jade.

"Are these spots called contaminated?"

Lu Xue asked in doubt.

"Yes, have you seen something?"

Xiao Yin asked immediately as he saw Lu Xue so seriously.

Hearing this, Lu Xue looked solemn and said slowly: "According to my observation, this jade is absolutely extraordinary. If it weren't for being polluted, then you, Xiao clan, will have a great opportunity."

Suddenly, the scene became a little quieter.

After a long time, Xiao Yin said indifferently: "Aren't you talking nonsense?"

"cough."

Lu Xue's face turned slightly red, and then pretended to continue watching.

"Well, I have a question. If this jade is destroyed, will your curse be lifted?"

Hearing this, Xiao Yin shook his head slightly.

Seeing this, Lu Xue frowned and said, "Can't you?"

However, Xiao Yin said, "It's not that we can't, but we can't destroy this stone at all, and we can't even leave a trace on it."

As soon as these words came out, Lu Xue immediately cheered up.

"You can't do it, I can do it."

"Let me try!"

Immediately, Lu Xue rolled up her sleeves and took out a dark golden hammer. The runes flowed on it, mysterious and mysterious. Just take a look, it seemed like you would be immersed in the infinite mystery.

Xiao Yin, who was standing beside him, also suddenly discovered the extraordinaryness of this hammer.

"Where did you get so many treasures?"

Xiao Yin said with a serious expression.

This is the first time she has seen such a treasure, including the Xuanyuan Sword that Lu Xue took out before, and the spear and shield, which are rare treasures.

Xiao Yin was sure that it was definitely a treasure above the level of immortal weapon.

Hearing this, Lu Xue smiled silently, "This, my father protects me."

As he said that, Lu Xue took out a few more talisman papers and pasted several pieces directly on her body. In just a moment, a steady stream of power surged out of the talisman paper.

After pondering for a moment, Lu Xue took out a few more posts and posted them on Xiao Yin, who was still a little confused.

After doing all this, Lu Xue carefully walked to the jade.

"Huh~"

"It's ready."

At this time, Xiao Yin finally reacted.

"Wait, do you really want it?!"

boom!

Before Xiao Yin could finish his words, Lu Xue had already knocked on him with one hammer.

Suddenly, a terrifying roar sounded and spread directly throughout the entire ancestral land.

All the Xiao people were shocked and forgot to come towards the direction of this place.

"In that direction?"

"not good!"

All the Xiao people rushed towards this place in an instant, their bodies tensed to the extreme.

At this time, Lu Xue and Xiao Yin were standing there, and the shock wave generated by the explosion hit the two of them, but they did not move at all and did not receive any damage.

Thanks to the power emitted by Lu Xue's talisman paper, the two of them were protected.

Of course, Lu Xue is the main one to protect.

The movement slowly dissipated. Lu Xue and Xiao Yin hurriedly looked at it. When they looked closely, they suddenly found that there was a crack on the originally smooth and flawless jade surface, and it was not small.

Seeing this scene, Xiao Yin was shocked and happy.

"Really, really possible?!"

"Miss Lu, you are so awesome!"

Hearing Xiao Yin’s praise, Lu Xue laughed, “That’s, that’s it.”

"Come on, see me continue."

"Uh-huh."

The two of them immediately became interested.

Just as Lu Xue was about to get the second hammer, an angry shout suddenly came from behind her.

"Rareless! Stop it now!!"

In an instant, Lu Xue and the others stopped and turned to look.

I saw a group of people rushing towards the two of them, all looking at them angrily.

"Xiao Yin, what's going on?!"

The beautiful woman questioned Xiao Yin.

The others looked at Lu Xue with some anger.

Seeing this, Lu Xue frowned and said, "Why are you staring at me? I'm saving you."

"Save us?"

At this time, Xiao Yin quickly stood up and explained.

"Sir, don't be excited, that's right."

After a long time, everyone finally understood why such a big noise came here.

Unexpectedly, Lu Xue actually planned to destroy the stone to save them.

Thinking of this, everyone was immediately ashamed.

At the same time, they were also shocked Lu Xue's ability. Even so many of their strong men could not shake, Lu Xue actually made a crack with just one hammer.

No wonder the Immortal King dared to enter the ancestral land of their Xiao clan.

It seems that there is something really.

"But, can you really lift the curse by breaking this stone?"

At this time, a member of the Xiao tribe suddenly said.

When everyone heard this, they were slightly stunned.

They really don't know, so this matter is risky.

Then do you want to break this stone?

For a moment, everyone present frowned.

Standing in front of the jade, Lu Xue twitched slightly. Could this hammer be smashed?

"Miss Lu, smash it."

Just as the Xiao clan members were hesitating, an old man suddenly said.

Everyone looked at the old man immediately.

"Xiao Mo, do you know what the consequences will be if an accident occurs?"

Some people from the Xiao tribe immediately questioned.

Hearing this, the old man named Xiao Modi said with a blank expression: "I don't know the consequences, I only know that if we are trapped here again, my Xiao clan will be really finished. At that time, Even if I can really go out, what's the point?"

Xiao Mo was the leader of the Xiao clan in the ancestral land three years ago.

At the same time, he is also the person in his ancestral land who knows the current situation of the Xiao clan best.

At that time alone, the Xiao clan was already facing a desperate situation.

Otherwise, I would not have taken the risk of entering the ancestral land to seek the last chance of the Xiao clan.

However, as expected, after entering the ancestral land, I could no longer get out.

Seeing that there were so many powerful people in the Xiao clan in the ancestral land, Xiao Mo was both happy and sad. He had the strength but could not display it. This was the most desperate thing.

Now, even if there is a glimmer of hope, Xiao Mo will never give up.
